item.title: Building Products, Understanding Customers
item.description: Technical builder working on agentic systems and products. Currently leading agent architecture and harness design for Jobdream and independently building an agentic platform that lets users create and publish games through vibe coding. Previously built ML systems in academic research and grew an investment-education community to 9,000+ subscribers. Interested in founding or joining a small, unusually strong team building AI-native products.

item.title: What Remains Valuable When Answers Become Cheap?
item.description:
What Remains Valuable When Answers Become Cheap?

AI is making answers cheap.

Code that once took hours can appear in minutes. Research that once required days of searching can begin with a conversation. A prototype that once needed a small team can increasingly be built by one person.

For a while, this made me wonder what happens to the value of technical skill itself.

If implementation keeps getting cheaper, what remains valuable?
